Concept deletion/replacement residue check for the story-level integrated change of B-137a: no blocker. Five concept migrations were identified from `git diff main...HEAD` and grep-verified repo-wide (excluding node_modules/dist/.git).

(1) SLOT REGISTRY RELOCATION. The provider admission slot registry moved from core/host-run.ts to core/provider-process-registry.ts. `lattice validate --concept` reports 13 deleted symbols and 234 residual references (acquireHostRunSlot, hostRunSlotsDir, isPidAlive, isSlotReclaimable, ownNumber, ownString, readSlotOccupant, releaseSlot, resolveMaxConcurrent, resolveSlotStaleMs, sameSlotOccupant, scanLiveSlots, writeSlotFileExclusive). I adjudicated every residual class and none is an orphan: acquireHostRunSlot, hostRunSlotsDir, releaseSlot, scanLiveSlots, writeSlotFileExclusive, resolveMaxConcurrent, resolveSlotStaleMs, HOST_RUN_MAX_CONCURRENT_DEFAULT, AcquiredHostRunSlot and HostRunLiveDescriptor all resolve through an explicitly labeled "Deprecated compatibility aliases" re-export block at core/host-run.ts:425-440 that delegates to the single canonical implementation; readSlotOccupant/sameSlotOccupant are private helpers that now live in core/provider-process-registry.ts:96,119; ownString/ownNumber are unrelated same-name private helpers in core/usage-sweep.ts:153,160; isPidAlive and isSlotReclaimable have zero remaining references anywhere. No duplicate implementation survives, and that is mechanically enforced by tasks/provider-process-registry-smoke.ts:460-461 (host-run must delegate, provider registry must not re-export host-run internals) and :474-479 (autopilot-executor and codex-review-leaf must use canonical terminology outside the compatibility boundary). Per the role contract, backward-compat retentions with an explicit deprecation comment do not count as residue.

(2) ON-DISK PATH REPLACEMENT. The slot directory moved from `.lattice/usage/host-run-slots/` to `.lattice/runtime/provider-process-slots/` (core/provider-process-registry.ts:30,170). Zero residue of the old path in source, docs, or .gitignore; the only occurrence is the negative assertion at tasks/proof-admissibility-registry-smoke.ts:292 that forbids it from reappearing in the usage doc. docs/host-run-usage.md:362 states the new path.

(3) RETIRED "LEDGER OFF => NO ADMISSION" CLAIM. The former doc/code claim that disabling the usage ledger makes a host run byte-identical with no admission and no slot files was removed and replaced by ledger-independent shared admission (docs/host-run-usage.md:355-395). Reintroduction is mechanically guarded for core/codex-review-leaf.ts, core/usage-ledger/writer.ts and tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts by tasks/provider-process-registry-smoke.ts:481-489. The one grep hit for the retired phrasing outside that guard is a prior review round's own transcript in docs/story/actives/B-137a/activity.jsonl, which is a historical evidence record and not a live claim.

(4) RETIRED agy ARGV-PROMPT EXECUTION. Identifier `requestAgy` has zero occurrences outside a single negative-control regex at tasks/command-catalog-smoke.ts:254. Surviving `agy` mentions are genuinely live surfaces, not residue: core/host-run.ts:1630-1635 refuses agy pre-spawn with an honest transport reason (prompt only in argv), and :1689 keeps it in the recognized-host set so the refusal is reachable rather than falling through to an unknown-host path.

(5) PER-ROLE "WAVE 4" PROMPT PARAGRAPHS COLLAPSED. Eight distinct per-role Wave 4 acceptance paragraphs were replaced by one shared mode-aware paragraph, applied consistently across all 16 agent assets in packages/main/templates/agents/, .claude/agents/ and .lattice-codex/agents/ (16/16 carry "Always read the canonical reports"). Surviving "Wave 4"/"Wave 3A" strings are a live milestone/rollout name in code comments, command descriptions (cli/command-catalog.ts:2694,2702), config comments (core/config.ts:79,123) and its own executable guard, not residue of a deleted concept. tasks/proofstory-pre-review-check-smoke.ts confirms "Wave 3A/Wave 4 leakage: absent" and that the canonical guidance is mode-aware across every active role and host mirror, including generated host mirrors.

Also confirmed non-deletions: lattice-review-channel is retained for backward compatibility with an explicit status 'retired' plus a mechanical invariant at core/prompt-role-contract-registry.ts:481-482. No files were deleted or renamed in this diff.

MANDATORY CLOSING SELF-CHECK (promised-but-undelivered): all 10 `lattice` commands appearing in the docs diff (autopilot, dispatch, doctor, host_run, host_run_cancel, host_run_status, managed_review_evidence_import, review_run_start, usage_sweep, validate) exist in cli/command-catalog.ts, and the three new ones are wired through registry.ts:401-402 via createHostRunHandlers and createManagedReviewEvidenceHandlers with real handler bodies (handlers/host-run.ts:655-662, handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:99-105). Doc-promised concepts managed_review_proposal_set, lattice.managed_review_final_proposal.v1, managed_reviewer, legacy_unmanaged, replacementSafe and runtimeContinuation all have real implementations in core/ and are referenced by production code, not only tests. Environment note, not a source defect: the `lattice` binary on PATH is 0.3.261 built from a different branch and does not know host_run_status/host_run_cancel/managed_review_evidence_import; this worktree's source is 0.3.255 (core/lattice-brand.ts:3) and does register all three, so the mismatch is a stale global binary rather than a missing implementation. No doc-promise-undelivered surface found.
